name: App Password Changed
description: Only used if pass-through authentication is configured. Sent when a user changes their login password or the password for any app or direct connect source connected to the source used for pass-through authentication.
subject: Important: Your ${PRODUCT_NAME} password update#if (${sourceFailedCount})#if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0) failed#{else} was successful#end#{else} was successful#end
body:
Password change notification

Dear ${user.name},

#if (${appCount}) #if (${appCount} > 0) #if (${appCount} > 1) #if (${appFailedCount} > 0)

Your password was changed for the following apps that share a password:

#{else}

Your password has been changed for the following apps that share a password:

#end #{else} #if (${appFailedCount} > 0)

Your password was changed for this app:

#{else}

Your password has been changed for this app:

#end #end

#foreach ($item in ${appList}) $item
#end

#end #{else} #if (${sourceCount} == 0) #if (${sourceFailedCount} == 0)

Your password has been changed in ${PRODUCT_NAME}.

#end #end #if (${sourceCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} == 0) #if (${appCount} == 0)

Your password has been changed in ${PRODUCT_NAME}.

#end #end #end #end #if (${appFailedCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} > 1) #if (${sourceCount} > 0)

However, your password failed to update for the following apps that also share this password:

#{else}

Your password failed to update for the following apps that also share this password:

#end #{else} #if (${sourceCount} > 0)

However, your password failed to update for the following app that also shares this password:

#{else}

Your password failed to update for the following app that also shares this password:

#end #end

#foreach ($item in ${appFailedList}) $item
#end

#{else} #if (${sourceFailedCount}) #if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0) #if (${sourceCount} > 0)

However, your password failed to update for all systems that share this password.

#{else}

Your password failed to update for all systems that also share this password.

#end #end #end #end #if (${appNotAttemptedCount} > 0) #if (${appNotAttemptedCount} > 1)

Because your primary authentication source failed to update, the following apps were not attempted:

#{else}

Because your primary authentication source failed to update, the following app was not attempted:

#end

#foreach ($item in ${appNotAttemptedList}) $item
#end

#{else} #if (${sourceNotAttemptedCount}) #if (${sourceNotAttemptedCount} > 0)

Because your primary authentication source failed to update, other systems that share this password were not attempted.

#end #end #end #if (${appFailedCount} > 0) #if (${appFailedCount} > 1)

Please try again to change your password on any of the failed apps. This change will apply to all apps listed in this email.

#{else}

Please try again to change your password on this failed app. This change will apply to all apps listed in this email.

#end #{else} #if (${sourceFailedCount}) #if (${sourceFailedCount} > 0)

Please try to change your password again. This change will apply to all systems and apps that share your password.

#end #end #end

If you did not make this change, please contact your IT administrator immediately.

Thank you,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
